methods.name: Coarse-to-Fine or Hierarchical Localization
methods.evidence_sentence: To date, most of the state-of-the-art WSVG methods follow a two-stage pipeline, i.e., firstly generating potential temporal proposals and then grounding with these proposal candidates.
